resource.boundary: Whole Java process and waited-for descendants, including startup/verification/recovery

limits: Three repetitions with one fixed seed; no statistical population/performance threshold claim.
Core is memory-only; durable loop includes queue/force/publication and is not HTTP throughput.
Closed-loop one outstanding command; coordinated omission and no overload latency claim.
No excluded system-driver warmup beyond64INITsetup; JIT/GC effects remain in measured commands.
Acknowledgement percentiles are per-run samples; summaries are medians/ranges of percentiles, not pooled percentiles.
ThreadMXBean allocation deltas include driver/writer/background live threads and can miss terminated threads.
Used heap is a point-in-time loop-end observation; maxRSS covers the whole JVM and native memory.
Recovery is warm JVM/hot OS page cache Gateway constructor, excluding digest verification/close.
JFR CPU/allocation samples and GC-log summaries cover setup/loop/verification/recovery; no exact force latency or matching-only allocation attribution.
Overlay storage underlying device/cache/power-loss behavior is unknown; process-crash tests are not physical power-loss tests.
Host has four quota cores despite five visible processors; no unrelated Java/apps at reservation or launch, but cloud-neighbor interference is unobservable.
Clean-checkout and global release/remoteCI remain coordinator work.

verifiedRuntimeArtifacts.checkAtAnalysis: Actual current cache check passed; source/artifacts unchanged from prepared measured launch. Trusted local receipt, not a signed remote attestation.
